### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>moby/sys (github.com/moby/sys/devices)</summary>

### [`v0.1.1`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/releases/tag/devices/v0.1.1)

#### What's Changed

- devices: skip `.incus-mounts` when listing devices ([#​261](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/261)).

  `GetDevices` walks every directory under the path it is given. On hosts running
  [Incus](https://linuxcontainers.org/incus/), there is a `/dev/.incus-mounts`
  directory with mode 0700. If the caller cannot read it, `GetDevices("/dev")`
  failed with "permission denied" and returned no devices at all.

  `.incus-mounts` is now skipped, as `.lxc`, `.lxd-mounts` and `.udev` already
  were. An unreadable directory with any other name still returns an error.
  Fixes [#​260](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/260).

#### New Contributors

- [@​SashaMIT](https://redirect.github.com/SashaMIT) made their first contribution in [#​261](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/261)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/moby/sys/compare/devices/v0.1.0...devices/v0.1.1>
